decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and disruptive tactics to out-value and outmaneuver opponent's strategies. By leveraging cards like Force of Will, Wasteland, and Fatal Push, it aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while fueling its own card advantage through cards like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a Companion provides additional value and recursion options. Overall, the deck aims to control the game tempo and win through incremental advantages and disruption.

The main theme of this deck is to utilize the Dredge mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures and spells, allowing for explosive plays and combos. By using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad, Golgari Thug, and Stinkweed Imp, the deck can effectively dredge cards into the graveyard and then utilize them for powerful effects. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with an army of creatures like Narcomoeba, Ichorid, and Prized Amalgam, supported by cards like Creeping Chill and Hollow One for additional damage and pressure. This deck aims to win through a fast and aggressive combo strategy.

The focus of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo using Coveted Jewel alongside cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Grim Monolith to generate mana and card advantage. The deck also includes powerful artifacts like Time Vault and Karn, the Great Creator to further enhance its combo potential. Additionally, cards like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor help provide interaction and disruption against opponents. The deck aims to efficiently ramp up its mana production, draw cards, and eventually win the game with a well-timed combo or overwhelming card advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using powerful counterspells, disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, and Orcish Bowmasters, along with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. The deck also utilizes card advantage with Ancestral Recall, Dig Through Time, and Treasure Cruise, while disrupting opponent's artifacts with Null Rod and Urza's Saga. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional recursion of key cards. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a 1 vs 1 setting.

The main focus of this Esper Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's plays while setting up for a strong late game. The deck utilizes various countermagic spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to stop threats, along with removal spells such as Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. It also has card advantage engines like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to stay ahead in resources. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for recurring key cards and keeping up pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Paradoxical Outcome card to generate significant card advantage and mana acceleration through various artifacts and spells. The inclusion of Thundertrap Trainer and Stock Up allows for additional card draw and manipulation, while the Mox cards and Mishra's Bauble provide extra mana ramp. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the opponent's strategies. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful plays and card advantage.

The deck revolves around generating massive card advantage and mana through Paradoxical Outcome, allowing the player to draw into key combo pieces and spells to win the game. The deck also utilizes powerful restricted Vintage cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Black Lotus to further fuel its strategy. By efficiently cycling through the deck and utilizing various mana sources, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful, explosive turn. Additionally, the presence of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds additional resilience and recursion to the deck.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly and efficiently through the use of fast mana rocks like Moxen, Sol Ring, and Mana Crypt. It utilizes card draw and tutoring effects to find and assemble the combo pieces of Tinker, Time Vault, and Voltaic Key or Manifold Key to take infinite turns. Paradoxical Outcome is a key card to generate card advantage and to dig deeper into the deck for combo pieces. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Chain of Vapor to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on assembling the Doomsday combo as quickly as possible, utilizing fast mana like Moxen and Dark Ritual, along with card draw and manipulation to find the necessary pieces. The goal is to cast Doomsday, then stack the deck in a way that allows for a win with Thassa's Oracle or using Demonic Consultation and Tainted Pact to exile the entire library. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo. The key is to carefully plan out the Doomsday pile in order to ensure a successful win.

The deck focuses on controlling the game with powerful counterspells and removal spells while also utilizing powerful card advantage engines like Ancestral Recall and Snapcaster Mage. It seeks to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing its own with a combination of efficient threats and disruptive elements. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and flexibility in the late game. Through a combination of efficient spells and disruptive elements, this deck aims to control the game's pace and ultimately outvalue the opponent.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly through cards like Black Lotus and Mana Crypt, while also utilizing artifacts like Mox Opal and Tolarian Academy. The main goal is to draw cards and bounce back artifacts with Paradoxical Outcome to generate even more mana and card advantage. With the help of cards like Force of Will for protection and Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck aims to assemble a combo that can quickly and efficiently close out the game before the opponent has a chance to respond.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures such as Blazing Rootwalla and Vengevine, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming aggro pressure. It includes various free spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its game plan and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck is designed to be proactive, fast, and aggressive, aiming to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish a strong board presence or develop their own game plan.

This deck focuses on maintaining control of the board while applying pressure with efficient creatures and disruptive spells. It utilizes powerful cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to answer threats, while cards like Lurrus of the Dream-Den and Mockingbird provide a consistent source of damage. The deck aims to tempo out opponents by countering key spells and establishing a strong board presence, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with evasive threats and efficient answers. The inclusion of powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk further solidify its aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly generating colorless mana through Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb to play powerful artifacts that disrupt opponents and apply pressure. Cards like Stonecoil Serpent, Golos, Tireless Pilgrim, and Patchwork Automaton provide threats while Sphere of Resistance, Trinisphere, and Chalice of the Void limit the opponent's ability to play spells effectively. Crucible of Worlds and Wasteland provide land destruction, and Karn, the Great Creator can shut down opposing artifacts. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient threats and disruptive elements to control the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through powerful spells and counters, with an emphasis on card advantage and disruption. It aims to quickly ramp up mana with fast artifact acceleration, while utilizing efficient counterspells and disruptive creatures to protect its game plan. By utilizing tutors and powerful draw spells, the deck can assemble key combo pieces or answers to threats as needed. The inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Bolas's Citadel provide additional utility and ways to generate advantage, making it a versatile and adaptable control deck.

The deck focuses on using Paradoxical Outcome to generate card advantage and mana while setting up a powerful combo with Time Vault and Manifold Key. It also includes a variety of powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Demonic Tutor to find key pieces of the combo quickly. Lurrus of the Dream-Den serves as a companion for the deck, providing additional value and recursion for key cards. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while controlling the game with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce.
